comment: The shared SGD recipe made architecture decisive. A and E combine rectifier activations with two LayerNorms; K1074 favored A’s normalized depth over E’s shallow network. K1039 favored both rectifier candidates over equal-LN GELU candidate B, while K1006 supported B over the zero-LN candidates despite its activation disadvantage. C over D was the least strongly supported comparison: deeper residual processing was a plausible advantage, and K1016 discouraged choosing D merely for its greater width. The gold ranking agrees with these scoped preferences; this question adds no tested general rule.
